package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgconn"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
	"github.com/vivym/vela/internal/admission"
	"github.com/vivym/vela/internal/identity"
	"github.com/vivym/vela/internal/scheduler"
)

func main() {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	authPool, err := pgxpool.New(ctx, os.Getenv("VELA_AUTH_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	defer authPool.Close()
	requestPool, err := pgxpool.New(ctx, os.Getenv("VELA_REQUEST_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	defer requestPool.Close()
	schedulerPool, err := pgxpool.New(ctx, os.Getenv("VELA_SCHEDULER_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	defer schedulerPool.Close()
	predictor, err := scheduler.NewCapacityPredictor(schedulerPool)
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	pepper, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(os.Getenv("VELA_CREDENTIAL_PEPPER_BASE64"))
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	principal, err := identity.NewAuthenticator(authPool, pepper).Authenticate(
		ctx, os.Getenv("VELA_BEARER_CREDENTIAL"),
	)
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	idempotencyKey := os.Getenv("VELA_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY")
	if idempotencyKey == "" {
		idempotencyKey = "n-minus-one-profile-circuit-" + uuid.NewString()
	}
	job, err := admission.NewService(requestPool, predictor).Submit(
		ctx,
		principal,
		uuid.MustParse(os.Getenv("VELA_PROJECT_ID")),
		idempotencyKey,
		admission.Request{
			Model:            "minimax-h3",
			GenerationPreset: "balanced",
			ServiceClass:     "standard",
			OutputSpec:       "video-1080p-5s-24fps",
			GenerationCount:  1,
			Prompt:           "prove exact N-1 Admission across Profile circuit expansion",
		},
	)
	if err != nil {
		if os.Getenv("VELA_EXPECT_DATABASE_FAILURE") == "true" {
			result := struct {
				JobID    string `json:"job_id"`
				SQLState string `json:"sqlstate"`
				Error    string `json:"error"`
			}{Error: err.Error()}
			var postgresError *pgconn.PgError
			if errors.As(err, &postgresError) {
				result.SQLState = postgresError.Code
			}
			if encodeErr := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(result); encodeErr != nil {
				fatal(encodeErr)
			}
			return
		}
		fatal(err)
	}
	if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(struct {
		JobID uuid.UUID `json:"job_id"`
	}{JobID: job.ID}); err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
}

func fatal(err error) {
	_, _ = fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
	os.Exit(1)
}
